clips.prompt:
Subject: Landscape 16:9, one continuous 11-second single-character narrative. Show exactly one physical instance of the established heavy adult adventurer from Picture 1. Preserve his broad heavy body, grounded weight, short dark hair, thick dark beard, tired experienced face, layered worn dark clothing, red scarf, crossing straps and buckles, pale metal shoulder and chest structure, complete backpack and rolled equipment, one cyan-lit waist lantern, heavy gloves and boots. Keep every connected item, body proportion, material, surface wear and reference color unchanged.

Movement: From 0 to 2 seconds he stands still with both boots planted and the complete load already settled. From 2 to 4 seconds one brief natural air movement crosses only existing foliage or the water surface visibly supported by Picture 2; it creates no new object and no danger. From 4 to 6 seconds only the existing loose edge of his scarf and the nearest attached cloth layer respond once, while his torso, boots and load remain grounded. From 6 to 8 seconds his eyes move first and his head turns only a few degrees toward the affected side, then stops. From 8 to 10 seconds one gloved hand travels once from its resting position to the already-existing diagonal chest strap, completes clear palm contact by the end of this interval and makes one small press; the hand must not stop in midair, touch a new strap or repeat the adjustment. From 10 to 11 seconds the hand remains visibly resting on that same strap while the cloth and load stop, forming a calm stable final result.

Scene: Picture 2 defines SCENE-04, the same forest-lake environment, its existing elements, spatial continuity and original five-color hierarchy. Use the brief air movement only if the bound scene image visibly supports existing foliage or water. Keep the background free of other people and person-like reflections. Do not invent a path, narrowing, obstacle, bridge, rock, root, building, sign, rail, creature, vehicle or new weather event.

Camera: One locked eye-level full-body medium-wide three-quarter view in a 16:9 landscape frame. Keep both boots, the full backpack silhouette, the complete hand-to-strap path and the final palm contact readable together. Fixed framing, focal length and horizon; no push, pull, pan, tilt, tracking, reframing, cut, transition or split screen. The same existing diagonal chest strap remains visible from first frame to last frame.

Lighting: Preserve Picture 1 materials and Picture 2 palette logic under one fixed soft diffuse light. Keep the cyan lantern as one small identity light only. No new glow, flashing, relighting, weather change, sudden saturation shift or color redesign.

Atmosphere: He reads as alert without alarm and experienced without theatricality. His appeal comes from noticing a small environmental change and completing one economical, deliberate equipment contact instead of leaving the response unfinished. Use clear two-dimensional hand-drawn shapes, restrained variable-width linework, soft diffuse depth and restrained shadows only where compatible with the bound references.

Audio: Ambient soundscape: quiet forest-lake air, distant water only if supported by Picture 2, one brief soft leaf-or-surface rustle, one cloth response, one faint existing-strap contact creak and low equipment weight. Emotional sound cue: one sparse non-melodic low tone rises slightly during the eye-and-head check and resolves only when the palm reaches the strap, with no lyrics and no strong beat. Audio supports action completion, spatial awareness and restrained emotion only; it does not drive cuts and is not music-video editing.

Negative: exactly one character and one physical body, no duplicate character, no second human figure, no split screen, no clone or mirror-double, no reflection person, no crowd, no NPC, no extra limbs, no text overlay, no watermark, no abrupt redesign, no young slim redesign, no removed backpack, no dropped equipment, no duplicate lantern, no new strap, no new buckle, no new weapon, no hand hovering short of the strap, no ambiguous hand endpoint, no repeated adjustment, no step, no panic, no run, no jump, no acrobatics, no invented object or scene geometry, no camera movement, no cut, no transition, no weather change, no abrupt color shift, no lyrics, no strong beat, no MV editing, no glossy 3D rendering.
